-->

## Checklist
- [ ] Visual only — no logic, data, or scoring changes (if it touches logic, say so above)
- [ ] Checked in **RTL / Hebrew** (WaffleStack is right-to-left)
- [ ] Checked on **mobile** width
- [ ] Preview URL opens and looks right
